description: Which prescription drugs Americans actually take for a given medical condition, with a national estimate of how many people take each one. Covers the whole US population — every payer, every age, commercial and uninsured included, not just Medicare or Medicaid. Ask with a plain condition name like "depression", "high cholesterol", "type 2 diabetes" or "asthma". Returns drugs ranked by estimated people treated, each with the survey sample behind it.

condition.description: Condition in plain words ("depression", "high blood pressure"), or a CCSR category code like MBD002.

min_sample.description: Minimum survey respondents behind a row, default 60 — AHRQ's own reliability floor. Lower it to see less-common drugs, which come back marked reliable:false because AHRQ would not publish them.

year.description: Survey year. Defaults to the most recent loaded.

name: meps_drugs_for_condition
title: Meps Drugs For Condition
